1st Order Spatial Point Patterns Analysis

Kernel density estimation with spatstat — bandwidth selection, fixed versus adaptive estimation, and the Clark-Evans test

2nd Order Spatial Point Patterns Analysis

Spatio-Temporal Point Patterns Analysis

Spatio-temporal kernel density with sparr and the space-time K-function with stpp, on 2023 forest fires in Bangka Belitung

Contiguity, fixed and adaptive distance and inverse-distance weights with spdep, and the four spatially lagged variables built from them, across Hunan's 88 counties
